title: Slugs
creator: Matt Bodett
description: A mixed-media collage that combines fine-line ink drawing with colorful hand-drawn lettering, stenciled letters, spray paint, and a collaged portrait fragment.
image_alt_text: Framed mixed-media work on a white background. Detailed black ink drawings of two hands and draped fabric fill the lower half. The word SLUGS is outlined in blue, yellow, red, and green above a brown cardboard stencil reading NHJVKL. A cartoon yellow sun sits in the top left corner, a cut-out fragment of a painted portrait in the top right, and pink and yellow spray paint with green looping lines lower right.
subject: collage;mixed media;drawing;hands
source: Ewing Gallery of Art + Architecture, University of Tennessee, Knoxville

title: Carousel
creator: Elizabeth James
description: A long horizontal panel showing a sequence of colorized MRI scan slices of a human head, moving from the back of the skull toward the face.
image_alt_text: A long, narrow black panel hung on a white wall, showing nine head scan slices in a row. They are colorized in saturated reds, pinks, yellows, and blues. From left to right the slices grow from a small brain cross-section to full skull views, ending with the eye sockets and face.
subject: medical imaging;MRI;brain;skull
source: Ewing Gallery of Art + Architecture, University of Tennessee, Knoxville

title: Kaleidoscope
creator: Elizabeth James
description: A triptych of three panels built from MRI imagery of the artist's brain, layered with bands and blocks of saturated color.
image_alt_text: Three horizontal rectangular panels hung side by side on a white wall. Each is an abstract composition of deep red, orange, yellow, and blue, cut by straight vertical and diagonal color bands. In the center panel a pale blue, folded brain-tissue shape is visible.
subject: medical imaging;MRI;brain;triptych
source: Ewing Gallery of Art + Architecture, University of Tennessee, Knoxville

title: Citrus Corners
creator: David Johnson
description: Eight dark, pillow-like forms of different sizes, each marked with a small orange dot, arranged on a reflective black Plexiglas surface. Cast plaster, paint, and Plexiglas.
image_alt_text: View from above of eight dark gray, soft-looking forms resembling small cushions or folded fabric, each with a small orange dot. They sit spread out on a glossy black Plexiglas surface that reflects the gallery's ceiling track lights. A wall label in the corner reads David Johnson, Citrus Corners, 2012, cast plaster, paint, and Plexiglas.
subject: sculpture;plaster;Plexiglas
source: Ewing Gallery of Art + Architecture, University of Tennessee, Knoxville

title: Transient Objects Caught in a Multi-Dimensional Moment of Impossible Pringles
creator: David Johnson
description: A small white 3D-printed sculpture of tangled, web-like strands forming an open cage shape, mounted on a green surface.
image_alt_text: View from above of a small white 3D-printed sculpture on a bright green square base. The sculpture is a loose, lacy cage of thin, melted-looking strands with a rounded knob extending to one side, casting a dark shadow. A label in the lower corner reads David Johnson, Transient Objects Caught in a Multi-Dimensional Moment of Impossible Pringles, 2020, 3D print.
subject: sculpture;3D printing
source: Ewing Gallery of Art + Architecture, University of Tennessee, Knoxville
